decision: DEVELOPMENT COMPLETE — READY FOR CONSOLIDATED E2E/UAT

genuineHumanUat.reason: Owner requested one consolidated UAT after development; no fresh login or additional genuine participants requested.

checks.name: Only exact manifest-owned R2 objects deleted; unrelated queues unchanged
All fixture sessions and temporary grants revoked
Foreign keys valid after fixture account deletion and R2 cleanup

resolvedDefects: Durable client request IDs prevent duplicate text/media-reference sends after a lost response.
Revision/nonce claims atomically gate report/appeal writes, notifications, media restoration and cleanup cancellation.
Safety roles cannot access identity-document routes; expired/revoked grants cannot be revived through legacy capability rows.
Reports/appeals/account queues paginate; search/status filters and urgency navigation reach real backend operations.

Discovery has stable candidate cursors/server filters and retains existing coarse 250m distance bands and enforces a minimum discovery query radius of 500m; 100m rating eligibility stays server-only. Portraits resolve inside SQL instead of an extra D1 call per card.
Optional API outages no longer take down the full app; core outages offer a working recovery action without invented members.
Gallery reuse in Chat requires ownership and recipient access; private grants do not permit redistribution. Gallery and Chat URLs recheck permission after revocation.
Public photos no longer close because the viewer lacks a Private Album grant; foreground comment refresh preserves drafts. Blocked authors are filtered server-side.
Online status stays opt-in, foreground/authenticated and expiring; offline reads stop and expired leases join retention cleanup.
Session management reveals no token/hash and preserves the current session when revoking others.
Cleanup lease prevents restoration during R2 deletion. Forwarded image-only messages are tombstoned before media deletion; R2-delete and D1-commit failures have distinct retry codes.
New release requires schema17 and exact-SHA consolidated UAT/rollout/migration approval; old owner-pilot approval cannot authorize it.
externalBlockers: Individually approved consenting genuine adult participants; none invited by this workstream.
Configure dedicated authorized Preview OAuth apps/callbacks and Turnstile; isolated project currently has no provider credentials. Do not copy Production secrets.
Approve expanded Social/location/media policy and operational scope, independent media appeal review, backup/emergency/appeals procedures and scanning decision.
Complete genuine UAT and explicitly approve Production migrations16/17, exact SHA rollout and selected service flags.
release: NO-GO for expanded Production/public launch until genuine UAT and external approvals pass
